mechanism: GUI control contention: stale active-window focus routes keyboard input to another actor's window

environment.desktop_resolution: Record from each Guest screenshot at runtime

document_actor.goal: The Document terminal file contains exactly Approved followed by one newline.

chat_actor.goal: The Chat terminal file contains exactly Review note followed by one newline.

conditions.solo: Run each actor independently from the same fixture; no partner actions.
conditions.ma_id: Run both actors on separate OSWorld Guest desktops using the same schedule; Track A has no persistent shared backend.
conditions.ma_sd: Run both actors on one OSWorld Guest desktop using the same schedule and shared focus, pointer, and keyboard.

failure_trigger: Chat actor validly activates Chat and submits its own note after Document actor's observation but before Document actor's keyboard entry.
recovery: Not injected by the scheduler. Actors may use their declared policy; this scripted Track A version deliberately tests open-loop continuation after the stored observation.
success_invariants: Every active actor's exact file goal passes.
No keyboard input is routed to a window other than the issuing actor's declared target.
reset: Reset each task Guest to the pinned clean OSWorld snapshot; both task files must be absent and every task Guest ID must differ from its clean-reset Guest ID.
